architecture.geometry_note: Path A. Apertus paper §2.5 long-context extension; the released swiss-ai/Apertus-8B-2509 config.json carries these values. Task 1 runs under a Path-B training-time override; see training_geometry block below.

training_geometry.source: Apertus paper §2.3 initial-pretraining geometry; matches the 4-arm bakeoff training command (--max-position-embeddings 4096 --rotary-base 500000).
training_geometry.rationale: Inherited from bakeoff for cross-arm comparability. The Task-1 regime-diagnostic question 'did the bakeoff regime degrade Vanilla?' requires the same positional geometry on both sides of the comparison. Switching mid-run invalidates the bakeoff-vs-this-run comparison that is the cleanest evidence for the regime hypothesis (iter 477 vs bakeoff Vanilla-2B = +4.65 pp outside V4 CI).
training_geometry.cost_of_path_b: Initializing from a Path-A checkpoint and training under Path B forces the model to re-adapt positional encoding from rope_theta=12M toward rope_theta=500K. Empirical evidence at iter 477: matched-config Apertus-Base (Path-B override on Path-A weights) yields Greek BPB=1.22 and MCQ headline=0.4272 — a 5.5 pp drop on MCQ and ~3x degradation on BPB. iter 477 (post-warmup, 2 B tokens) recovers BPB to ~0.43 and MCQ to 0.4792, at Apertus-Base Path-A point estimate (0.4817). First ~1 B tokens carry the rope-adaptation cost.

matched_config_diagnostic.status_note: Used as DIAGNOSTIC of how rope-perturbation degrades Apertus-Base. NOT a clean baseline — the rope_theta override perturbs the model rather than re-anchoring it. Primary comparison for the regime hypothesis is iter-N vs bakeoff Vanilla at matched token marks (both on Path B).

task2_geometry_recommendation.rationale: Task 2 (production extension experiment) does NOT need bakeoff comparability. Switching to Path A removes the ~1 B tokens of rope re-adaptation cost and removes the geometry-confound for any Apertus-Base comparison. Primary Task-2 comparison is extension-vs-Vanilla under the same regime + same geometry, not extension-vs-bakeoff-arms.
task2_geometry_recommendation.status: CONFIRMED, LOCKED for Task 2 v1.x by the 2026-05-31 Path-A 0.5B probe; do not reopen unless running an explicit geometry ablation.
